protocol.timer: perf_counter_ns, CUDA synchronize immediately before and after policy.act
protocol.included_work: policy state/entity and batch preparation, transfers, full-team actor, temporal update, legal action selection, action decoding
protocol.excluded_work: model loading, policy reset, warmup, environment physics/opponent update, centralized value diagnostics, recording and file I/O
protocol.main_average: sum elapsed over calls with >=1 live defender / count of those calls
protocol.secondary_average: all actual policy.act calls, including zero-live tails, retained separately
protocol.sd: sample SD of the 20 episode active-step means; descriptive scene variation, not training-seed uncertainty
protocol.warmup: 10 reset-and-forward calls on the first measured scene initial state for each arm/config; no extra episodes
protocol.order: serial; rotate seven arms by scene index and configuration index
protocol.checkpoint_configuration: loaded unchanged; only fixed execution depth set

protocol.module_loading: bypass eager HAD package initializers via package search paths; import unchanged model/controller modules
protocol.startup_note: Initial import failed before any model decision because open_score package initializer required had_env; no measured calls in that attempt
protocol.padding: compact: N defenders + N attackers + 2 targets; all present/alive
protocol.input: one identical deterministic synthetic entity table per count, shared by all seven arms
protocol.history: fixed previous actions arange(N) % 9; restore zero GRU state before each call outside timer
protocol.timer: perf_counter_ns, CUDA synchronize immediately before and after mac.select_actions plus CPU action-list materialization
protocol.included_work: controller input concatenation/masking, full-team actor, temporal update, existing greedy action selector, action output to CPU list
protocol.excluded_work: model loading, synthetic feature preparation, initial GPU upload, hidden-state restoration, warmup, environment, centralized mixer, recording/file I/O
protocol.statistics: arithmetic mean of 100 full-team calls; sample SD across calls retained in raw summary
protocol.order: serial; rotate the 14 cells by repetition index
protocol.checkpoint_configuration: saved architecture and weights unchanged; resize count metadata and set execution depth only
